fix: push all local fixes + add final quality check to fetch path

- Add _is_garbage_content(), _has_valid_summary()
- Add final quality fallback to fetch path (was only in --articles-json path)
- Rewrite _enrich_article_content() with site-specific extractors
- These fixes were committed locally but git push 443 timed out

fix(dedup): reduce lookback to 2h + skip empty runs (all steps skipped)

- Reduce lookback window from 6h to 2h to prevent yesterday's late runs from blocking today's trigger
- For runs with conclusion=success, check if Step 2 was actually executed (not skipped) via jobs API
- Prevents cascading skip: empty runs marked as success no longer block future runs
